profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Toyota Financial Services Corporation
profile.summary:
I am a highly self motivated Software Engineer with over 20 years of experience in design and
development creating distributed systems in various business domains including E-Commerce,
inventory management, tax preparation, banking, and fulfillment services. I have extensive
experience in both developing software as a commercial product and ground up IT application
development.
I enjoy continuous learning and mentoring others. I am always eager to learn other programming
languages, new technologies, development practices, and business domains. I am an experienced
technical servant leader who believes in Agile Practices, an Always Learning Mentality, and
promoting collaborative, positive, self managed teams that work together to meet customer needs.

Current experience includes:

• Advanced Java, Sprint Boot, Spring framework
• Microservices, REST Services (Jersey, JAXRS, Spring MVC), JSON, Basic experience with
Apache Kafka
• NoSQL Cassandra, PostgreSQL Database, SQL, JDBC
• Junit, Mockito, Intuit Karate, familiarity with TDD, Experience using continuous builds with Jenkins and Blue Ocean build pipelines, JaCoCo
• Agile/Scrum principles, Splunk logging, Linux, GIT / GITHUB, Tomcat, UML, IntelliJ, Familiarity with Github Copilot
• Familiarity with AWS EC2, AWS S3, AWS Lambdas, ArgoCD 
• Object-oriented Design expertise, Database Design experience, and familiarity with GoF Design Patterns, Enterprise Integration Patterns (Addison Wesley Signature Series), Enterprise Application Architecture Patterns (Addison Wesley Signature Series), and Domain Driven Design. Well versed in data structures and algorithms. 

Previous experience includes:
• JMS/messaging with Oracle AQ, ActiveMQ and IBM Q
• SOAP services (JAXWS: Contract First), XML 
• HTML, CSS, Javascript, ReactJS with Redux, Cucumber
• Oracle Database, SQL Server, Hibernate
• Jetty, Weblogic, Apache Server, (S)FTP, Eclipse
• TestNg, Spock (groovy test framework)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lacerte Desktop and Intuit ProConnect Services:

Led development adding new third party Smart-Vault document management features to ProConnect Application. Involved working with four different groups at Intuit providing open contributions to Intuit common services to communicate with the third party document management system SmartVault. 

Key developer in refactoring and maintaining Purchase Orchestration Service. Various projects from refactoring to use new back end order services to adding discount, promo, and user fee features. Built with Java REST services and Spring Boot.

Key contributor to creating new ProConnect Reporting services reporting essential firm e-file data to tax accountant firm owners. Built with Spring Boot Java REST Services and messaging using Kafka with Apache Flink

Key contributor in creating new Audit Protection services providing customer with efile Audit Protection. Managed technical relationship with third party company Tax Protection Plus contacts. Service SME and owner. Led development of various feature changes such as Business Return and Previous Year Return support. Created with Spring Boot, Java REST Services. 

Key contributor upgrading ProConnect Online to Intuits ReactJS player technology including 2 years working with HTML, CSS, Javascript using ReactJs and Redux in the Return Input / Check Return screens. Key contributor to the Java REST service Input View Catalog Management System providing dynamic JSON defined views to React UI.

Lacerte Calc and Content Acquisition Services:

Developed a new government tax artifact acquisition and management system. The system crawls government sites to download tax definition documents for the Lacerte and Intuit Tax Online products. 

Developed new Continuous Software Release Management services used by Intuit Lacerte and Intuit Online Tax products. Enables smaller more continuous delivery of software updates to the customer.

Merged Filed Jointly/ Filed Separately worksheet processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Development · Spring · Spring Boot · Software Design · ActiveMQ · Apache Kafka · Cassandra

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical lead working with an excellent team co-located in San Diego and Allen, Texas. We worked together to create the first version of the Symitar SymXchange services product. The product allowed for 3rd party vendors and credit union customers to have direct access to the Episys Credit Union Core Engine through services. The SymXchange adoption rate by customers was at approximately 75% of the customer base. 

Created SOAP service code generation framework to generate the SymXchange services based on a database schema representing the credit union core legacy PL1 database.

Promoted from individual contributor to technical lead role within first three months. 

Substitute Scrum Master and key contributor in helping product owner create and manage product backlog. 

Participated as part of interviewing panel for software engineering candidates

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
IIS THUNDR Program: Tactical Handoff Using Nearest DCGS Resource

Key contributor in releasing first commercially sold product version of THUNDR 

Refactored the Reliable UDP communication framework to enhance its extensibility, efficiency, and durability. Involved Java concurrency programming providing reliable UDP messaging, Servlet programming with Jetty and JBoss, and Oracle database expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dell Management plugin for VMware vCenter: 

Product Group Engineer supporting three different Agile scrum teams from a technical perspective in creating one of Dell Product Group’s first software packages as a product “Dell Management Plugin for VMware vCenter”. The product was listed as one of the top 15 products for the year 2011 by CRN. CRN - Dell VMWare Power Management Plugin

Dell ODM Fulfillment Channels: 

Developed an Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) fulfillment system using SOA practices which was responsible for all of Dell’s ODM system orders across the globe including key contributions in enabling the Asia ODM region. 

Dell Asia Pacific Outbound Logistics/Fulfillment Channel: 

Technical lead / Solutions Architect working with three different teams, one in Malaysia, two in China, building from the ground up a message oriented Asia Pacific Outbound Fulfillment system that provided end to end order visibility throughout the entire network to Dell Customers.

Dell Inventory Management System: 

Technical Track Lead working with 8 USA and 19 offshore India developers building a custom inventory management system that was a key enabler to increase Dell’s manufacturing uptime by abstracting the financial inventory system of record from the tactical facility inventory system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dell Third Party Fulfillment System:

Refactored Dell’s third-party product fulfillment channel’s architecture from database polling based system written in ASP and VB to a JMS message based system.

Once the system was selected to be the global footprint for all third party fulfillment for Dell, I was a key engineer that planned the architecture of GFX to better handle internalization requirements by providing localization, more extensible domain model, and improved scalability. Designed and developed single code base supporting Europe, Latin America, Canada, Asia, and USA. The same system is still in production today with the same framework processing hundreds of thousands of orders per week.

 E–Commerce Dell Software and Accessories (Dell.com):

Served as Key developer in the redesign of Dell Gigabuys to become Dell Software and Accessories, performing various roles for Dell.com's application Software and Accessories including L2 support and technical consultant to the business. 

Prototyped a new J++ search engine/cache that increased the speed and scalability of the application to allow for new functionality in the search process.

Led the first global implementation of the application to provide functionality to Canada and USA for Dell Home and Small Business. 

Was co-lead on a core project taking the Dell Home and Small business global implementation, upgrading it to C#, and merging features from the various implementations of the older versions from different business segments into one core global version.
